subject.title: [Feature]: Cost metadata support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models

question: Should user-supplied pricing for discovered Bedrock models live as a Bedrock plugin-local discovery overlay, or as a generic model-cost overlay shared by future discovered providers?
rationale: The code path is clear, but adding a new user-visible config surface is compatibility-sensitive and the repository policy prefers provider-owned behavior unless a generic core seam is justified.

options.title: Use Bedrock plugin-local overlay
options.body: Add a backward-compatible `plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery.costs` map and apply it inside the Bedrock discovery plugin only.

options.title: Design generic model costs overlay
options.body: Add a top-level provider/model pricing overlay that can patch any discovered provider, but only after maintainers define precedence with explicit provider costs and pricing-cache data.

options.title: Keep explicit provider models only
options.body: Decline a new overlay and document that exact local pricing requires explicit `models.providers.amazon-bedrock.models[]` entries.

recommendation.title: Use Bedrock plugin-local overlay
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible `plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery.costs` map and apply it inside the Bedrock discovery plugin only.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about config surface and provider/plugin ownership, and steipete authored the current plugin-owned discovery config move.
